story_type: litter hoist onto a fishing boat that keeps moving, seen from the door and from a second aircraft
hook: The boat never stopped. The litter had to land anyway.
narration: This fishing boat kept plowing ahead while a litter swung toward its deck.
A crewman on the Potluck was hurt, about sixty miles east of Chincoteague, Virginia.
A Jayhawk crew from Air Station Elizabeth City came in low beside the boat.
A litter keeps an injured person flat and strapped in, so the ride up can't make a back or neck injury worse.
On the rolling deck, his crewmates got him into it.
Then the cable took the load.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew hoisted the injured fisherman up and into the helicopter.
title: Litter lands on a moving fishing boat
description:
On Aug. 8, 2012, a Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Air Station Elizabeth City, North Carolina, medevaced an injured crewmember from the fishing vessel Potluck about 60 miles east of Chincoteague, Virginia.
